title: Spec Engine — ScaffoldPlan Contract (spec->scaffold plan, now with real codegen)
description: Machine-checkable form of the spec->scaffold plan (TESS-VISION-AND-BUILD-SPEC.html Phase 1 Epic E2 deliverable (3), continued into the codegen slice of Phase 2 Epic E4's 'scaffolds the repo from SPEC.md'). `codegen_status` is `not_started` immediately after `spec_engine.scaffold.plan_scaffold_from_spec()` (a PLAN only, no filesystem access) and becomes `generated` once `spec_engine.codegen.generate_app()` has actually written real files for it — see that module's docstring, and `.spec-engine/codegen-manifest.json` (schema: `codegen-manifest.schema.json`), for the honest PER-MODULE generation status this single top-level enum cannot carry on its own (some modules are fully generated, others are labeled stubs). This is the exact shape `spec_engine.types.ScaffoldPlan.to_log_record()` emits and the literal content of `.spec-engine/scaffold-plan.json` that `spec_engine.scaffold.write_scaffold_stub()` writes into a generated app's repo.

source_section.description: Which part of the spec this module was derived from, e.g. 'data_model.entities[0]' or 'how_it_looks.key_screens[1]' — traceability back to the source of truth.
